$comment: Exported interfaces that declare the same fields under different names. Shape is not meaning, so merging is not required; silence is. Every group names an owner and a reason, and SHAPE-002 warns when a group stops being duplicated, so this list can only shrink.

AudioSessionError|ControlError|RpcError.reason: one transport error shape, three domains. The `code` fields are different unions despite identical spelling, so collapsing them would erase the distinction between a protocol rejection and an audio processor failure; each domain keeps its own declaration and converts at the boundary.

ControlMarker|TimeMarker|TimeMarkerResul.reason: the video marker shape exists once in Content and once in each contract entry the two bundles can reach. The Content copy is the runtime owner; the contract copies are the wire form both hosts validate against.

ControlScreenshotResult|ScreenshotResult.reason: the protocol result and the control-plane alias of it. The control alias exists so the control vocabulary stays self-describing at call sites; they are structurally identical by design.
